	}
}

# Finalize: production-weighted market price + origin effective surplus.
#
# 1. Adds origin's own production x local_price to wavg sums
# 2. market_price = sum(prod x price) / sum(prod)
# 3. Computes origin's effective surplus:
#    eff = max(buy,sell) x (market_price - own_price) / market_price
#    eff > 0: state is cheap -> stl_eff_export (should export)
#    eff < 0: state is expensive -> stl_eff_import (should import)
# Phase C reads stl_eff_export/stl_eff_import for trade decisions.
#
# If no production in network (wsum = 0), market_price retains
# its previous value as fallback (NOT zeroed by Phase C).
# Scope: state (origin, same as stl_gravity_self)
stl_phase_b_finalize_prices = {
	# --- grain ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:grain.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:grain.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 20 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 20 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 20 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 20 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_grain add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_grain add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_grain > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_grain
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_grain
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_grain
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_grain value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_grain }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_grain var:stl_market_price_grain > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_grain
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_grain
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_grain }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_grain }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_grain }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_grain }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_grain
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_grain >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_grain value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_grain } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_grain value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_grain
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_grain
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_grain >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_grain value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_grain } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_grain value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_grain
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_grain value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_grain value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- fish ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:fish.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:fish.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 20 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 20 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 20 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 20 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_fish add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_fish add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_fish > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_fish
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_fish
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_fish
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_fish value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_fish }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_fish var:stl_market_price_fish > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_fish
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_fish
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_fish }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_fish }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_fish }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_fish }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_fish
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_fish >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fish value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_fish } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fish value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_fish
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_fish
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_fish >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fish value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_fish } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fish value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_fish
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fish value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fish value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- fabric ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:fabric.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:fabric.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 20 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 20 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 20 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 20 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_fabric add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_fabric add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_fabric > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_fabric
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_fabric
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_fabric
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_fabric value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_fabric }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_fabric var:stl_market_price_fabric > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_fabric
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_fabric
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_fabric }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_fabric }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_fabric }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_fabric }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_fabric
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_fabric >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fabric value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_fabric } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fabric value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_fabric
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_fabric
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_fabric >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fabric value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_fabric } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fabric value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_fabric
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fabric value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fabric value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- wood ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:wood.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:wood.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 20 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 20 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 20 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 20 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_wood add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_wood add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_wood > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_wood
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_wood
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_wood
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_wood value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_wood }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_wood var:stl_market_price_wood > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_wood
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_wood
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_wood }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_wood }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_wood }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_wood }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_wood
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_wood >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_wood value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_wood } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_wood value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_wood
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_wood
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_wood >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_wood value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_wood } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_wood value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_wood
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_wood value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_wood value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- groceries ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:groceries.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:groceries.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 30 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 30 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 30 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 30 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_groceries add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_groceries add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_groceries > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_groceries
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_groceries
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_groceries
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_groceries value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_groceries }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_groceries var:stl_market_price_groceries > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_groceries
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_groceries
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_groceries }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_groceries }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_groceries }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_groceries }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_groceries
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_groceries >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_groceries value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_groceries } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_groceries value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_groceries
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_groceries
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_groceries >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_groceries value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_groceries } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_groceries value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_groceries
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_groceries value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {

		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_paper add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_paper add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_paper > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_paper
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_paper
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_paper
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_paper value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_paper }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_paper var:stl_market_price_paper > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_paper
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_paper
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_paper }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_paper }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_paper }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_paper }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_paper
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_paper >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_paper value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_paper } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_paper value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_paper
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_paper
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_paper >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_paper value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_paper } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_paper value = 0 }
				}
			}

				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_paper
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_paper value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }

				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_iron value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- lead ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:lead.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:lead.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 40 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 40 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 40 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 40 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_lead add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_lead add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_lead > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_lead
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_lead
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_lead
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_lead value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_lead }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_lead var:stl_market_price_lead > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_lead
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_lead
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_lead }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_lead }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_lead }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_lead }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_lead
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_lead >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_lead value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_lead } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_lead value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_lead
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_lead
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_lead >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_lead value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_lead } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_lead value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_lead
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_lead value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_lead value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}

				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_rubber >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_rubber value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_rubber } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_rubber value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_rubber
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_rubber
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_rubber >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_rubber value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_rubber } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_rubber value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_rubber
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_rubber value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_rubber value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- oil ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:oil.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:oil.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 40 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 40 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 40 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 40 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_oil add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_oil add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_oil > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_oil
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_oil
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_oil
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_oil value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_oil }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_oil var:stl_market_price_oil > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_oil
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_oil
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_oil }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_oil }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_oil }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_oil }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_oil
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_oil >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_oil value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_oil } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_oil value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_oil
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_oil
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_oil >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_oil value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_oil } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_oil value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_oil
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_oil value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_oil value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}

			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_clippers
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_clippers
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_clippers value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_clippers }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_clippers var:stl_market_price_clippers > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_clippers
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_clippers
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_clippers }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_clippers }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_clippers }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_clippers }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_clippers
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_clippers >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_clippers value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_clippers } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_clippers value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_clippers
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_clippers
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_clippers >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_clippers value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_clippers } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_clippers value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_clippers
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_clippers value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}

				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_clippers value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }

	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 40 }

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 40 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 40 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 40 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_tools add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_tools add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_tools > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_tools
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_tools
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_tools
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_tools value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_tools }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_tools var:stl_market_price_tools > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_tools
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_tools
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_tools }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_tools }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_tools }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_tools }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_tools
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_tools >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tools value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_tools } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tools value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_tools
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_tools
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_tools >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tools value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_tools } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tools value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_tools
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tools value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tools value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- steel ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:steel.state_goods_consumption } }

				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_explosives
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_explosives
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_explosives >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_explosives value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_explosives } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_explosives value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_explosives
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_explosives value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_explosives value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- ammunition ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:ammunition.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:ammunition.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 50 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 50 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 50 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 50 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_ammunition add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_ammunition add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_ammunition > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_ammunition
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_ammunition
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_ammunition
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_ammunition value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_ammunition }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_ammunition var:stl_market_price_ammunition > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_ammunition
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_ammunition
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_ammunition }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_ammunition }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_ammunition }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_ammunition }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_ammunition
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_ammunition >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_ammunition value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_ammunition } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_ammunition value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_ammunition
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_ammunition
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_ammunition >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_ammunition value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_ammunition } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_ammunition value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_ammunition
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_ammunition value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {

			}

		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_tanks value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_tanks }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_tanks var:stl_market_price_tanks > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_tanks
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_tanks
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_tanks }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_tanks }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_tanks }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_tanks }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_tanks
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_tanks >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tanks value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_tanks } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tanks value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_tanks
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_tanks
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_tanks >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tanks value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_tanks } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tanks value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_tanks
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tanks value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tanks value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- aeroplanes ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:aeroplanes.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:aeroplanes.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 80 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 80 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 80 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 80 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_aeroplanes add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_aeroplanes add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_aeroplanes > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_aeroplanes
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_aeroplanes
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_aeroplanes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_aeroplanes value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_aeroplanes }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_aeroplanes var:stl_market_price_aeroplanes > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_aeroplanes
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_aeroplanes
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_aeroplanes }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_aeroplanes }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_aeroplanes }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_aeroplanes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_aeroplanes
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_aeroplanes >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_aeroplanes value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_aeroplanes } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_aeroplanes value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_aeroplanes
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_aeroplanes
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_aeroplanes >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_aeroplanes value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_aeroplanes } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_aeroplanes value = 0 }

					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }

	# --- meat ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:meat.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:meat.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 30 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 30 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 30 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 30 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_meat add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_meat add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_meat > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_meat
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_meat
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_meat
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_meat value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_meat }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_meat var:stl_market_price_meat > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_meat
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_meat
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_meat }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_meat }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_meat }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_meat }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_meat
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_meat >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_meat value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_meat } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_meat value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_meat
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_meat
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_meat >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_meat value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_meat } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_meat value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_meat
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_meat value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_meat value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- fruit ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:fruit.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:fruit.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 30 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 30 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 30 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 30 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_fruit add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_fruit add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_fruit > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_fruit
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_fruit
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_fruit
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_fruit value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_fruit }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_fruit var:stl_market_price_fruit > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_fruit
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_fruit
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_fruit }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_fruit }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_fruit }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_fruit }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_fruit
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_fruit >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fruit value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_fruit } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fruit value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_fruit
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_fruit
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_fruit >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fruit value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_fruit } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fruit value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_fruit
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fruit value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fruit value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- sugar ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:sugar.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:sugar.state_goods_production } }

	if = {

		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price

		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 30 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 30 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_sugar add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_sugar add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_sugar > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_sugar
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_sugar
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_sugar
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_sugar value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_sugar }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_sugar var:stl_market_price_sugar > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_sugar
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_sugar
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_sugar }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_sugar }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_sugar }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_sugar }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_sugar
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_sugar >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_sugar value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_sugar } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_sugar value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_sugar
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_sugar
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_sugar >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_sugar value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_sugar } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_sugar value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_sugar
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_sugar value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_sugar value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- tobacco ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:tobacco.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:tobacco.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 40 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }

		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
