		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 40 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 40 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_tobacco add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_tobacco add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_tobacco > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_tobacco
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_tobacco
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_tobacco
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_tobacco value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_tobacco }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_tobacco var:stl_market_price_tobacco > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_tobacco
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_tobacco
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_tobacco }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_tobacco }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_tobacco }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_tobacco }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_tobacco
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_tobacco >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tobacco value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_tobacco } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tobacco value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_tobacco
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_tobacco
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_tobacco >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tobacco value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_tobacco } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tobacco value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_tobacco
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_tobacco value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_tobacco value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- liquor ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:liquor.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:liquor.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 30 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 30 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 30 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 30 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_liquor add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_liquor add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_liquor > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_liquor
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_liquor
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_liquor
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_liquor value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_liquor }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_liquor var:stl_market_price_liquor > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_liquor
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_liquor
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_liquor }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_liquor }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_liquor }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_liquor }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_liquor
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_liquor >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_liquor value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_liquor } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_liquor value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_liquor
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_liquor
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_liquor >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_liquor value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_liquor } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_liquor value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_liquor
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_liquor value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_liquor value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}

		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }

	if = {

		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_wine
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_wine
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}

			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_wine }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_wine }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }

					name = stl_eff_import_wine
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_wine >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_wine value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_wine } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_wine value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }

					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }

			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_coffee value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_coffee }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_coffee var:stl_market_price_coffee > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_coffee
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_coffee
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_coffee }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_coffee }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_coffee }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_coffee }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_coffee
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_coffee >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_coffee value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_coffee } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_coffee value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_coffee
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_coffee
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_coffee >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_coffee value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_coffee } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_coffee value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_coffee
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_coffee value = local_var:stl_own_eff }

		}

	# --- luxury_furniture ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:luxury_furniture.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:luxury_furniture.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 60 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 60 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 60 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 60 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_luxury_furniture add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_luxury_furniture add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_luxury_furniture > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_luxury_furniture
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_luxury_furniture
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_luxury_furniture
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_luxury_furniture value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_luxury_furniture }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_luxury_furniture var:stl_market_price_luxury_furniture > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_luxury_furniture
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_luxury_furniture
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_luxury_furniture }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_luxury_furniture }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_luxury_furniture }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_luxury_furniture }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_luxury_furniture
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_luxury_furniture >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_luxury_furniture value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_luxury_furniture } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_luxury_furniture value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_luxury_furniture
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_luxury_furniture
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_luxury_furniture >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_luxury_furniture value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_luxury_furniture } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_luxury_furniture value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_luxury_furniture
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_luxury_furniture value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_luxury_furniture value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}

			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_radios
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_radios >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_radios value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_radios } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_radios value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_radios
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_radios
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_radios >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_radios value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_radios } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_radios value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_radios
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_radios value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_radios value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
	# --- fine_art ---
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_buy value = { value = sg:fine_art.state_goods_consumption } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_sell value = { value = sg:fine_art.state_goods_production } }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = 200 }
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_sell >= local_var:stl_own_buy } }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_min_bs value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_min_bs > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_ratio
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_buy subtract = local_var:stl_own_sell divide = local_var:stl_min_bs }
		}
		if = { limit = { local_var:stl_own_ratio > 1 } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_ratio >= -1 } } set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_ratio value = -1 } }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_price
			value = { value = local_var:stl_own_ratio multiply = 0.75 add = 1 multiply = 200 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 1.75 multiply = 200 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_buy > local_var:stl_own_sell } }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_price value = { value = 0.25 multiply = 200 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > 0.01 }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_psum_fine_art add = { value = local_var:stl_own_sell multiply = local_var:stl_own_price } }
		change_variable = { name = stl_wavg_wsum_fine_art add = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:stl_wavg_wsum_fine_art > 0.01 }
		set_variable = {
			name = stl_weighted_avg_price_fine_art
			value = {
				value = var:stl_wavg_psum_fine_art
				divide = var:stl_wavg_wsum_fine_art
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = stl_market_price_fine_art value = var:stl_weighted_avg_price_fine_art }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_buy }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_sell > local_var:stl_own_buy }
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_own_econ value = local_var:stl_own_sell }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:stl_own_econ > 0.01 has_variable = stl_market_price_fine_art var:stl_market_price_fine_art > 0.01 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = stl_own_eff
			value = {
				value = var:stl_market_price_fine_art
				subtract = local_var:stl_own_price
				divide = var:stl_market_price_fine_art
				multiply = local_var:stl_own_econ
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_import_fine_art }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_imp value = var:stl_last_import_fine_art }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = stl_last_export_fine_art }
			set_local_variable = { name = stl_prev_exp value = var:stl_last_export_fine_art }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_fine_art
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_import_fine_art >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fine_art value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_import_fine_art } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fine_art value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_import_fine_art
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_imp subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_fine_art
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { var:stl_eff_export_fine_art >= 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fine_art value = { value = 0 subtract = var:stl_eff_export_fine_art } }
					set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fine_art value = 0 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 }
				set_variable = {
					name = stl_eff_export_fine_art
					value = { value = local_var:stl_prev_exp add = local_var:stl_own_eff }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_imp > 0.5 } NOT = { local_var:stl_prev_exp > 0.5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:stl_own_eff > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_export_fine_art value = local_var:stl_own_eff }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { local_var:stl_own_eff >= 0 } }
				set_variable = { name = stl_eff_import_fine_art value = { value = 0 subtract = local_var:stl_own_eff } }
			}
		}
	}
}
